source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fix replaces getUTCDate with getUTCDay when indexing the seven-column expected-highlight mapping. The views harness sets calendar.week.start=4, so the mapping is scoped to its Thursday-first week. The direct assertion compares the day-column-today class with the expected column. This corrects the inspected test expectation; it does not establish a production-view fix or timezone/midnight runtime coverage. No browser test ran.
title: The current-day week-view test indexes its column mapping with the weekday
